source_changes: Uncommitted at the time of the runs; committed with this receipt. Includes the backend add fix, compact card schema, repetition penalty, reaper fix, voice options, and UI fixes.

offline_restart.method: unshare -n -r with loopback up; connections to 1.1.1.1:443 and huggingface.co:443 failed
offline_restart.scope: Chat and decision only. Voice, fonts, and history were not exercised.

first_visible_answer.procedure: 2 warmups, 30 measured turns, one persistent pair, ~170-token prompt, 256-token allowance, clock stops at first text event
first_visible_answer.cause: A 792-token card schema was prefilled on every chat turn. The chat worker alone returned its first chunk in 0.78 s for a 170-token prompt.
first_visible_answer.not_measured: Thermal state. Peak memory. Cold-start figure separate from warm.

everyday_2b.note: Model writes a markdown list; no assistant-ui fence. A reminder made it write JSON under the wrong fence tag.

quality_27b.note: Decode about 3 tokens/s on a GPU shared with other jobs. Timing not qualified.

speech_output.before_fix: Low-frequency hum: 98% of energy below 1 kHz, spectral flatness 0.002. The owner: not speech.
speech_output.root_cause: Elementwise add of two transposed views scrambled output positions on the Vulkan backend.

after_fix.worst_sentence_note: number words versus digits; 0.01 overall when normalized
after_fix.real_time_factor: 0.13 to 0.19 (5 to 6 times slower than real time)

speech_output.listener: The owner listened to the first voice: clear, crisp, but Chinese-accented. Default is now aiden; the owner has not yet confirmed the accent.

defects_fixed: Card schema prefilled on every chat turn
Greedy decoding looped on the 2B model until the token cap
Unclaimed reservation of a dead creator blocked every restart after a reboot during pair start
Elementwise add of two transposed views scrambled output on the Vulkan backend (speech was a hum)
not_run: speech input: no Linux path (Parakeet needs the ANE encoder)
standing M1 battery and zero-CPU dispatch trace
clean installation on a fresh machine (needs a release that contains the assistant)
Quality pair latency on an idle GPU
login_service: install.sh writes and enables mlx-omarchy-chat.service for a real user home. It was not enabled on the shared test GPU.
